description: Land Acquisition - Kahatuduwa, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Divilla Yatawatte D/S Division, Matale District (Section 07)
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act regarding the government's intention to acquire specific lands for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots, including their names, descriptions, claimants, original claimants, and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative actions.
